spec_case: issue #674: a mid-stream disconnect retries like any other dropped connection
description: The mock server closes the connection after two NDJSON deltas, before the `done: true` line; the attempt fails (curl's premature-EOF exit, classified retryable the same as a dropped connection) and the retry's fresh request gets a complete reply. Curl's own text (the exact byte count read before the drop) never reaches the final state outside `meta.attempts`, where the first (failed) attempt's own text is masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md), not pinned by this case.
